title: Common
description: Shared definitions referenced by every Cloudhal contract. Not a root type: the bundler inlines these $defs into each root schema before code generation.

Id.description: Prefixed, URL-safe identifier, e.g. site_01HZX8K3Q9. The prefix names the entity kind; agents and the MCP server pass these as opaque handles.

Revision.description: Monotonic per-node revision used for optimistic locking (compare-and-swap on write).

SchemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Readers reject unknown versions; migrations move documents forward one version at a time.

Locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, e.g. en, tr, en-US.

Metadata.description: Free-form string-to-string map for extensions. Keys should be namespaced (e.g. cloudhal.source).

ActorKind.description: Who performed an action. Humans and agents share one actor model so the policy engine treats them uniformly.

ImageRef.description: Reference to a media asset. src may be a relative asset path or an absolute URL.

PublishStatus.description: Editorial lifecycle of a page or content entry.
